title: 「In large part」表示「很大程度上／主要地」
titleZh: 「In large part」表示「很大程度上／主要地」

source.file: Sentence Structure 211 -「In large part」表示「很大程度上／主要地」.pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF has no English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation.
The source filename is numbered 211; it is assigned system ID ss212 because the source set contains two distinct PDFs labelled 201.

formula: Subject + verb + in large part + because / due to / owing to + reason

formulas.formula: Subject + verb + in large part + because + clause
Subject + be + due / owing / thanks in large part to + noun phrase
Subject + be + caused / influenced / explained in large part by + noun phrase
Subject + depend in large part on / result in large part from + noun phrase

example: The success of the project was due in large part to careful planning.
exampleZh: 這個項目的成功，很大程度上歸功於周詳的規劃。

examples.en: The success of the project was due in large part to careful planning.
examples.zh: 這個項目的成功，很大程度上歸功於周詳的規劃。
examples.highlight: The success of the project was due in large part to careful planning.

meaning.zh: 本課練習目標句型：Subject + verb + in large part + because / due to / owing to + reason。

rules.zh: 表示「主要」，但不表示「全部」 In large part 表示某個因素非常重要，但通常暗示還有其他因素。 （項目能夠成功，很大程度上是因為周詳的規劃。） 這句並不是說周詳規劃是唯一原因。
rules.en: It means “mainly”, not “entirely”. In large part presents one factor as very important while normally implying that other factors also exist. “The project succeeded in large part because of careful planning” does not say that planning was the only reason.
examples: The project succeeded in large part because of careful planning.

rules.zh: 不要加入 a 正確： 錯誤： In a large part of the city 是另一種意思，表示「在城市的一大片區域內」，並不表示「很大程度 上」。
rules.en: Do not add a. Correct: in large part. Incorrect for the target meaning: in a large part. “In a large part of the city” has a different meaning: it refers to a large physical area of the city, not to a great degree.

rules.zh: 注意常見搭配的位置 以下搭配最自然：
rules.en: Pay attention to the phrase’s natural position in common combinations: due in large part to; caused in large part by; influenced in large part by; shaped in large part by; based in large part on; depend in large part on; result in large part from; succeed in large part because; improve in large part through; and reduce something in large part by doing something.
examples: reduce something in large part by doing something

rules.zh: 放在句首時通常加逗號 但放在句中時通常不需要逗號：
rules.en: When in large part comes first, normally put a comma after it: In large part, the difference resulted from regular practice. In the middle of the sentence, a comma is normally unnecessary: The difference resulted in large part from regular practice.
examples: In large part, the difference resulted from regular practice.
The difference resulted in large part from regular practice.

rules.zh: 必須是影響較大的因素 如某個因素只產生很小的影響，便不宜使用 in large part。 不自然： 較自然：
rules.en: Use the phrase only for a factor with a substantial influence. If a factor had only a small effect, in large part is unsuitable. Unnatural: The event succeeded in large part because one guest arrived five minutes early. More natural: The event succeeded in large part because the organisers had prepared carefully.
examples: The event succeeded in large part because one guest arrived five minutes early.
The event succeeded in large part because the organisers had prepared carefully.

rules.zh: 與 for the most part 不完全相同 In large part 經常說明某件事在多大程度上由某個原因造成。 （這項改變很大程度上是由公眾壓力造成的。） For the most part 通常表示「大致上」或「在大多數情況下」。 （大致上，大部分學生都理解了課堂內容。）
rules.en: In large part and for the most part are not identical. In large part often states the degree to which a cause produced an outcome: The change happened in large part because of public pressure. For the most part normally means generally or in most cases: For the most part, the students understood the lesson.
examples: The change happened in large part because of public pressure.
For the most part, the students understood the lesson.

benefits.zh: 避免把說法講得過分絕對 使用普通的原因句時，讀者有時可能以為你只提出一個原因。 （項目因為周詳規劃而成功。） 加入 in large part 後，你可以清楚表示周詳規劃是主要原因，但可能仍有其他因素。 （項目能夠成功，很大程度上是因為周詳的規劃。）
benefits.en: It helps you avoid making an overly strong claim. An ordinary causal statement may sound as though it gives the only cause: The project succeeded because of careful planning. Adding in large part identifies careful planning as the main cause while leaving room for others: The project succeeded in large part because of careful planning.

benefits.zh: 清楚說明某個因素有多重要 這個句型不只是指出原因，還能表示該原因佔了相當大的比重。 （這項改善是由恆常練習造成的。） （這項改善很大程度上是由恆常練習造成的。） 第二句更清楚交代恆常練習的重要程度。
benefits.en: It shows how important a factor is, not merely that it is a cause. Compare: The improvement was caused by regular practice. The improvement was caused in large part by regular practice. The second sentence makes the substantial contribution of regular practice clearer.

benefits.zh: 為其他原因保留空間 現實中的結果通常由多個因素共同造成。使用 in large part，可以指出最重要的因素，同時避免 說它是唯一因素。 這對作文、報告、討論社會問題和分析事件特別實用。
benefits.en: It leaves room for other explanations. Real outcomes usually have several causes; in large part identifies the most important factor without claiming that it is the only one. This is especially useful in essays, reports, discussions of social issues and analyses of events.

benefits.zh: 令分析和解釋更清楚 你可以使用以下固定框架，有條理地連接「結果」和「主要因素」： 這些框架讓讀者立即看出兩個部分之間的關係。
benefits.en: It helps you write clearer explanations. Frames such as be due in large part to, be caused in large part by, depend in large part on and result in large part from connect an outcome with its main factor in an orderly way and make the relationship immediately visible.

benefits.zh: 增加句式變化 你不必每次都使用： 使用 in large part 可以令說話和寫作較少重複，並讓原因分析聽起來更自然和有分寸。
benefits.en: It gives you more sentence variety. Instead of repeatedly using mainly because, largely because, one main reason is or a major factor is, use in large part to make causal analysis sound natural, measured and less repetitive.
